findings.text:
DSCLA-10: 1 part to fix
DSCLA-10[code]: When the run refuses to start because zbuild:claimed is on the issue, pipeline.refused.claimed is emitted to the event bus covers: RQCLA-3 [FIX IN DESIGN: RQCLA-3 asks only that the run refuses to start with non-zero exit and no stage dispatched; it does not ask for an event to be emitted to the event bus — the issue does not ask for this; take it out, or make it what the issue asks]
  Given: zbuild:claimed is already on the issue
  When: a run is started on that issue
  Then: pipeline.refused.claimed is emitted to the event bus

answers: test-author finding 1: not mine — The exit 12 is caused by DSCLA-9 assertions correctly failing on old code (expected behavior for a [code] SPEC), which stops the test file before DSCLA-1's assertion can be checked. DSCLA-1 tests `zbuild_claim_acquire` directly (a new function, not yet present on old code) and belongs in its own unit test; DSCLA-9 tests via the runner and belongs in an integration test. Putting them in the same file means the first failure stops the second from running. The SPEC descriptions are correctly written and unambiguous; test file separation is the test author's decision, not mine.
